verdict.rationale: Square's own Payouts API lists payouts and lets you filter them by location, status and time range, which partly covers seeing when payouts land. Nothing in the evidence documents next-day or instant transfers. The 'Manage your cash flow' line is generic marketing and does not show a faster-payout option. Missing for 10: next-day/instant transfer capability, explicit payout arrival dates or schedule in a seller-facing view, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see when each payout lands and speed it up (next-day or instant) when I need the cash

citations.quote: Learn how to filter payouts by location ID, status, and time range and sort them in ascending or descending order.
